reason: The hypothesis cites evidence for HEA hardness and wear resistance (E4, E5, E6) and for coating TC4 with other materials (E1, E2), but no cited evidence demonstrates successful application of an HEA coating to TC4 or that such a coating preserves TC4's bulk properties; the mechanism linking hardness to reduced adhesive/abrasive wear is only partially supported by the cited HEA wear data, which shows abrasive and oxidation wear, not adhesive.
premises: HEA coatings can be applied to TC4 surfaces
HEA coatings possess high hardness and strength
High hardness and strength improve wear resistance by reducing adhesive and abrasive wear
HEA coatings have stable microstructures that resist oxidation and corrosion
The HEA coating will not sacrifice TC4's existing beneficial properties
